description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “90 N Cartagena Main House”, a luxurious Rosemary Beach retreat blending coastal charm with modern comfort. Designed for unforgettable gatherings, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home sleeps 12 and boasts a private, seasonally-heated pool, expansive outdoor living, and premium amenities. Whether you’re soaking up the sun poolside, enjoying cocktails on the wrap-around balcony, or exploring 30A’s scenic paths on one of the 6 included bikes, your perfect beach escape begins here. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Coveted Rosemary Beach Location — Steps from private beach access and four sparkling community poolsPrivate, Seasonally-Heated Pool Retreat — Lounge, dine, and relax by your own backyard oasis, complete with an outdoor fireplace, al fresco dining for 12, and cozy seatingExpansive Wrap-Around Balcony — Accessible from all 2nd-floor bedrooms, this balcony invites you to unwind with morning coffee or sunset drinksChef’s Dream Kitchen — Spacious and stylish with stainless steel appliances, dual ice makers, a wine cooler, and bar seating for 4Outdoor Living at Its Best — Features a built-in gas grill, mini fridge, fireplace, and generous seating for memorable evenings under the stars6 Adult Bikes Included — Perfect for exploring Rosemary Beach’s cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and vibrant diningThoughtfully Designed for Groups — Flexible spaces, a bunk room for the kids, and inviting interiors that make relaxation effortless*** LIVING AREAS ***Gather in the bright and airy living room where plush seating meets coastal style. Large windows frame the pool view, creating a seamless connection to outdoor spaces.Large living area with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TVOpen layout that connects to dining and kitchenEasy access to the private pool deck and patio*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The spacious kitchen is ready for casual bites or feast-worthy dinners. Outfitted with everything you need to entertain with ease.Stainless steel appliances, including gas range, dual ice makers, and wine coolerBar seating for 4 at the generous kitchen counterDining table with seating for 8Poolside dining for 12 beneath the stars*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bath — Convenient powder room off the kitchen2nd Floor: Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, dedicated workspace, en-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower, soaking tub, and balcony accessKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access, shared guest bathroom with single vanity & shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access3rd Floor:Twin Guest Suite: 6 Twin beds, flat-screen TV, en-suite with single vanity & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step into your private backyard retreat, where a seasonally heated pool, outdoor kitchen, and cozy fireplace create the perfect setting for al fresco dining, lounging, and unforgettable evenings. The spacious wrap-around balcony offers a peaceful spot for morning coffee or sunset cocktails with coastal breezes.Private, seasonally heated pool for year-round enjoymentOutdoor kitchen with gas grill, mini fridge, and fireplaceGenerous al fresco dining space for 12 + lounge seatingExpansive 2nd-floor wrap-around balcony with ample seating for relaxationPerfect blend of sun, shade, and fresh air for all-day comfort*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Situated in the heart of Rosemary Beach, 90 N Cartagena Main House offers the perfect blend of privacy, luxury, and convenience. Enjoy easy access to the community’s private beach, beautiful pools, and the vibrant energy of 30A’s most beloved destination.Private Rosemary Beach access—just a short stroll to sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and beach adventuresAccess to 4 stunning community pools, including the heated Sky Pool and family-friendly Cabana Pool6 adult bikes included—cruise along 30A’s scenic trails to explore boutique shops, gourmet dining, parks, and neighboring communitiesMoments from Peddler’s Pavilion, live music, and seasonal events for entertainment the whole family will enjoyA prime location that’s walkable to Rosemary Beach’s iconic architecture, cozy cafés, and charming green spaces*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes but can be purchased during the reservation process or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 6 included bikes; additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesPool is seasonally heated from September 1 to April 30LSVs are not permitted in Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach or Seacrest BeachGuests may park up to 2 vehicles directly in front of the garage doors. Please note that space is limited to two vehicles; any additional cars will need to use street parking. The garage is not available for parking.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 83926STRO #: STR-221798
